clips.title: The story
paras: Reclaiming the Charred Vale is an Alliance quest offered by Keeper Albagorm atop Stonetalon Peak. It charges adventurers with culling the aggressive Bloodfury harpies who occupy the ruined valley of the Charred Vale, clearing a path so druids and caretakers can begin healing the scorched landscape.

To the south of Stonetalon Peak lies the Charred Vale, a once-lush alpine haven reduced to ash and smoldering ruins. The devastation began when a mechanized logging and mining army swept through the sacred crags, stripping trees and fueling uncontrolled blazes. For the guardians stationed around Stonetalon, watching ancient woodland succumb to industrial greed is an intolerable wound upon the wilderness.

While mechanical fires sparked the ruin, an opportunistic infestation took root in the ashes. The vicious Bloodfury harpies swarmed into the smoking lowlands, establishing nests and aggressively ambushing anyone approaching the valley. Keeper Albagorm and his allies cannot even walk the soil to sow the seeds of renewal, as the Bloodfuries violently refuse passage to all outsiders.

Before any meaningful restoration can take place, the roosts of the Bloodfury tribe must be broken. Albagorm tasks seasoned Alliance fighters with carving deep into their numbers—slaying hunters, ambushers, and roguefeathers alike. Thinning their predatory flocks is the vital first step toward reclaiming what belongs to nature and giving the forest spirits room to breathe once more.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a protector of the forest spirits you can undoubtedly guess why I am alarmed.
You have traveled through these mountains to reach this peak. Surely you have seen the travesty which has befallen the land. Greed has led to the destruction of these sacred hills.
The Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Worse yet, the Bloodfuries that have encroached on the land refuse us passage in to begin regrowth.
Drive the wretched harpies out, friend!

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is much work to be done before the Charred Vale can be restored to the lush forest it once was.
Clear the area of those foul menaces, Friend! Only then can we begin to reclaim what belongs to nature.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now that the Bloodfuries have suffered such a great loss, perhaps the true work of restoring the land can begin....
